description: General-purpose utility scripts for Morgana. Includes diagnostics, wait/sleep helpers, directory inspection, and PowerShell parameter-passing tests. Use these scripts to validate agent connectivity, test tag substitution, and sanity-check your Morgana setup before running adversary emulation packs.
author: X3M.AI
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Windows Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed

tag_categories.label: Sleep / Wait
tag_categories.description: Parameters for the sleep script. Controls how long the agent pauses before reporting back.

tags.label: Sleep duration (seconds)
tags.description: Number of seconds the script will wait before completing. Use this to simulate slow execution, test timeout handling, or pad a chain step.

tag_categories.label: Directory Test
tag_categories.description: Parameters for the directory listing test script. Controls which directory is inspected and what file pattern is searched.

tags.label: Directory to inspect
tags.description: Full path to the directory whose contents will be listed by the test script. Must exist on the target machine.

tags.label: File filter pattern
tags.description: Wildcard filter passed to Get-ChildItem -Filter. Use '*' to list everything, or a pattern like '*.exe' to narrow results.

tags.label: Max items to display
tags.description: Limits the output to this many items. Prevents excessive output when listing large directories.

tag_categories.label: PowerShell Parameter Test
tag_categories.description: Parameters for the PowerShell parameter-passing test script. Validates that tag substitution works end-to-end and that parameters reach the agent correctly.

tags.label: Greeting message
tags.description: A short text string that is printed by the test script to confirm that tag substitution worked correctly.

tags.label: Repeat count
tags.description: How many times the greeting is printed. Useful for verifying that the numeric parameter type is handled correctly.

scripts.name: Excalibur - General-T0000-Sleep Wait
scripts.description: Pauses execution on the agent for a configurable number of seconds then reports back. Use this to simulate slow-running steps in a chain, test agent keep-alive behavior, or insert a timed delay between chain steps. Duration is controlled by the excalibur_util_sleep_seconds tag.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] Sleep/Wait utility'; $seconds = [int]'#{excalibur_util_sleep_seconds}'; if ($seconds -le 0) { $seconds = 10 }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Sleeping for ' + $seconds + ' second(s)...'); Start-Sleep -Seconds $seconds; Write-Host ('[SUCCESS] Sleep completed after ' + $seconds + ' second(s)')

scripts.name: Excalibur - General-T0001-Directory Listing Test
scripts.description: Changes to a configurable directory and lists its contents using Get-ChildItem. Supports a file filter pattern and a max-items cap. Use this to confirm the agent is running with the expected working directory, verify filesystem access, and validate tag substitution with multiple parameters in a single script.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] Directory listing test'; $targetDir = '#{excalibur_util_dir_path}'; $filterPattern = '#{excalibur_util_dir_filter}'; $maxItems = [int]'#{excalibur_util_dir_maxitems}'; if ($maxItems -le 0) { $maxItems = 20 }; if (-not (Test-Path $targetDir)) { Write-Host ('[ERROR] Directory not found: ' + $targetDir); exit 1 }; Set-Location -Path $targetDir; $cwd = (Get-Location).Path; Write-Host ('[INFO] Changed to: ' + $cwd); Write-Host ('[INFO] Listing up to ' + $maxItems + ' item(s) matching: ' + $filterPattern); $items = Get-ChildItem -Path $targetDir -Filter $filterPattern -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First $maxItems; if ($items.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host '[INFO] No items match the filter in this directory' } else { $items | ForEach-Object { $size = if ($_.PSIsContainer) { '[DIR]' } else { ($_.Length.ToString() + ' bytes') }; Write-Host ('  ' + $_.Name + '  ' + $size) } }; Write-Host ('[SUCCESS] Listed ' + $items.Count + ' item(s) from: ' + $cwd)
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] Directory listing test: no cleanup required'

scripts.name: Excalibur - General-T0002-PowerShell Parameter Test
scripts.description: Launches a PowerShell child process passing two parameters: a greeting text and a repeat count. Validates the full tag-substitution pipeline end-to-end: admin value -> script-level override -> command placeholder -> agent execution. Ideal as a first test after installing a new agent or configuring a new workspace.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] PowerShell parameter test'; $greeting = '#{excalibur_util_param_greeting}'; $repeat = [int]'#{excalibur_util_param_repeat}'; if ($repeat -le 0) { $repeat = 1 }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Greeting: ' + $greeting + '  Repeat: ' + $repeat); $scriptBlock = 'param($msg, $n) for ($i=1; $i -le $n; $i++) { Write-Host ("[" + $i + "/" + $n + "] " + $msg) }'; $encoded = [Convert]::ToBase64String([System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes($scriptBlock)); $proc = Start-Process powershell.exe -ArgumentList ('-NoProfile', '-EncodedCommand', $encoded, '-', $greeting, $repeat) -Wait -PassThru -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('[SUCCESS] Child process exited with code: ' + $proc.ExitCode + '. Tag substitution validated.')
scripts.cleanup_command: Write-Host '[INFO] PowerShell parameter test: no cleanup required'

chains.name: Excalibur - General-Chain-Full Connectivity Check
chains.description: Runs all three utility scripts in sequence: sleep -> directory listing -> parameter test. Use this as a complete agent health check after initial installation or after changing agent configuration.

chains.name: Excalibur - General-Chain-Tag Substitution Smoke Test
chains.description: Runs only the parameter test script. Minimal chain to quickly verify that tag substitution works correctly from admin or per-script override values.
